title: Cost Nudger Orchestrator: operator-escrowed canary + gated apply for batching & KV-presets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement an 'Cost Nudger Orchestrator' that safely promotes Optimize recommendations (batch size, prefix/KV caching candidates, quantization presets) from suggestion -> staged canary -> operator-escrowed apply. The orchestrator should provide a short safety runway (thermostat) that can throttle adoption if latency or error rate regressions exceed configurable thresholds. Key goals: (1) minimize manual toil for low-risk, high-gain suggestions; (2) ensure rapid rollback and human-in-the-loop control for customer-facing routes; (3) produce clear artifact links and telemetry for post-apply analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can schedule a recommendation into a 3-stage rollout: simulate -> traffic-sampled canary (1%) -> staged increase (1%, 5%, 20%) -> operator-escrowed full apply
If any canary step breaches SLO thresholds (p50 latency, p95 latency, 5xx rate), rollout automatically halts and opens an operator escrow ticket
Support manual escrow apply/abort via Console action and a lightweight CLI (redwood optimize apply --escrow ENG-853214)
All applied changes are tagged with a unique rollout id and recorded in audit logs with before/after kernel-profile snapshots
Simulation lab can replay representative traffic from the last 48h and surface token-cost delta and latency delta pre/post change
Fast rollback path performs a lethal revert (apply previous config) within 30s for dedicated and hosted routes
Telemetry dashboards show per-rollout token-cost, p50/p95 latencies, KV cache hit-rate, and modeled savings against observed quality regressions
Documentation and runbook for operator escrow exist and are linked in the rollout UI
implementation_steps: Design rollout state machine and thermostat logic (tickets: design doc in Confluence)
Extend Optimize recommendations API to include 'risk score' and simulated-savings metadata
Build canary fraction controller integrated with routing layer (1% traffic split with sampling by user-id/hash)
Add prefix/KV cache compatibility checks and guard for sequence length skew
Implement automatic telemetry checks and circuit-breaker that opens escrow on violations
Console UX: escrow action, rollout timeline, telemetry thumbnails, and operator annotations
CLI: lightweight commands to list, inspect, apply, and abort escrowed rollouts
E2E tests: simulated-replay validations and fault-injection for rollback behavior
Staging rollout: enable for internal customers then pilot with two external teams
risks_and_mitigations: Latency regressions from aggressive batch sizing -> mitigation: conservative default risk score and staged increments
Cache-incoherence when enabling prefix caching on routes with dynamic prompts -> mitigation: run compatibility checker and only enable on routes with median seq <= configured threshold
False-positive safety halts causing ops churn -> mitigation: add hysteresis windows (3 consecutive breaches) and human-ack override during business hours
Auditing/Compliance concerns with automatic applies -> mitigation: operator escrow requires two-step approval for P0 customers and full audit log sent to KMS-backed storage
